Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Reduced connected-room frame-time and idle network overhead with allocation-free match snapshots, cached library ordering, and WebSockets with a 30-second keepalive. Sit/doze anywhere is now an opt-in toggle instead of an automatic fallback.
